[EN] General Dadun sounds confident, but I heard a rumor that part of the army has actually taken the field!

If that's true, there's good reason to worry.
[ES] El General Dadun suena seguro, ¡pero escuché el rumor de que parte del ejército ya ha entrado en combate!

Si eso es verdad, hay buenas razones para preocuparse.
